{{Quote|My father fought with the Republic Navy at Venestria and Ord Trasi, ''[&hellip;]''.|From the memoirs of Isila Drutch|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Venestria''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Venestria system/Legends|Venestria system]], a part of the [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]] in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It lay on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Kwevron system/Legends|Kwevron systems]], and another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Cezith system/Legends|Cezith system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Venestria was the origin point of the art form known as [[Venestrian poetry]].<ref name="Blasters">{{JournalCite|3|Blasters for Hire}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Venestrian poetry]]|system=[[Venestria system/Legends|Venestria system]] and Venestria itself|legends=1}}</ref> At some point during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="EGTW" /> of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Isila Drutch's father|father]] of the future [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Isila Drutch]] served with the [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at a [[Battle at Venestria|confrontation]] at Venestria. In their memoirs, written in [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]], Drutch mentioned their [[Parent/Legends|father's]] participation in the action at Venestria.<ref name="EGTW" /> Venestria fell within the borders of the [[Pentastar Alignment]] between [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] and [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venestria was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA" />
